senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of שַׁעַר)to keep the gate.—V. שׁוֹעֵר.

units: <cite ref="Arakhin 11b:9">Arakh. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>משורר ששי׳ בשל חבירו</he> a Levite chorister that helped in attending to the gate in his neighbor’s stead.—Part. <he>מְשׁוֹעֵר</he>; pl. <he>מְשׁוֹעֲרִים</he> (formed by analogy to <cite ref="M02843"><he>מְשׁוֹרֵר</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="U01054"><he>שִׁיר</he> I</cite>).

<cite ref="Arakhin 11b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא מן המש׳</he> (<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 116:1">Sifré Num. 116</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 752:9">Yalk. ib. 752</cite> <he>השׁוֹעֲרִים</he>), v. <cite ref="U01054"><he>שִׁיר</he> I</cite>.
